column1: # Arabic (ar) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty          a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code (`tl!("…")`,
#                           a menu label, or a name the UI translates with `i18n::t`)
#            anything else  a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns;
#            translators may reorder them. A trailing "…" (dialog commands) is kept.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text using ordinary
# Arabic video-editing vocabulary (تسلسل، مسار، مقطع، المخطط الزمني، رأس التشغيل…). No proprietary
# localisation resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same
# way. Product and technology names (FilmCraft, ArtCraft, Lumetri, ProRes, LUFS…) keep their
# spelling. Western digits (0-9), the Arabic comma ، and a masculine-neutral style (مصدر) are used.
# Status: pilot — the core menus, panels, workspaces, settings and dialogs. Strings the catalog
